Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q. What is the Thyrocare Metabolic Profile Basic test?
Ans.
The Thyrocare Metabolic Profile Basic is a comprehensive health check-up package that assesses your core metabolic functions. It covers essential parameters related to liver health, kidney function, blood sugar levels, lipid profile, and uric acid. This test is helpful in identifying early signs of lifestyle disorders such as diabetes, high cholesterol, and liver or kidney issues.
Q. Who should consider getting this test?
Ans.
This test is suitable for anyone looking to monitor their general health, especially those with a sedentary lifestyle, a family history of metabolic disorders, or symptoms like frequent fatigue, unexplained weight changes, or high blood pressure. It’s also recommended as a preventive health check-up for adults.
Q. What parameters are included in this test?
Ans.
The package generally includes tests to evaluate liver function, kidney function, fasting blood sugar, cholesterol and lipid levels, and uric acid levels. The exact components may vary slightly depending on your location or lab processing.
Q. Is fasting required before the test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting is necessary. You should avoid eating or drinking anything except plain water for 10 to 12 hours before the sample is collected. This ensures more accurate test results.
Q. What kind of samples are collected for this test?
Ans.
A blood sample is required for this test. In some cases, a urine sample may also be requested depending on the specific version of the test offered.
Q. When will I receive my test results?
Ans.
You can expect to receive your test reports within 24 to 48 hours after your sample has been collected. The reports are usually shared via email, WhatsApp, or through an online portal.
Q. Can I book a home sample collection for this test?
Ans.
Yes, home sample collection is available in most Indian cities. A trained technician will visit your location at your chosen time to collect the sample safely and conveniently.
Q. Is a doctor’s prescription needed to take this test?
Ans.
No, you do not need a prescription to book this test. However, after receiving your report, it is advisable to consult a healthcare professional for interpretation and further guidance.
Q. How frequently should I take this test?
Ans.
For general health tracking, it is recommended to undergo this test once every year. If you already have a diagnosed metabolic condition such as diabetes or high cholesterol, your doctor may advise more frequent testing based on your health status.

Q. What is the Thyrocare Infertility Profile Advanced test?
Ans.
The Infertility Profile Advanced is a detailed diagnostic package that assesses multiple hormonal and metabolic factors that can affect fertility in both men and women. This profile offers deeper insights compared to the basic version and is helpful in evaluating ovulation, ovarian reserve, thyroid health, and other hormonal imbalances that may interfere with conception.
Q. Who should consider this test?
Ans.
Couples who have been trying to conceive for more than six months without success should consider this test. It is especially beneficial for women with irregular periods, suspected PCOS, or past miscarriages, and for men with suspected low testosterone or sperm production issues. It is also a useful screening tool before planning assisted reproductive treatments like IVF or IUI.
Q. What tests are included in this package?
Ans.
This advanced profile typically includes a wide range of tests such as Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH), Luteinizing Hormone (LH), Prolactin, Estradiol (E2), Testosterone, Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH), TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone), Free T3, Free T4, and additional tests that give a more comprehensive picture of reproductive health. Q. Is fasting required for this test?
Ans.
Fasting is usually not required for infertility hormone tests. However, it is advisable to follow the lab’s instructions, as certain tests may need to be performed at a specific time in the menstrual cycle for women.
Q. What type of sample is collected?
Ans.
A blood sample is collected for this test. The sample is analysed to check various hormone levels that are critical for fertility and reproductive function.
Q. When will I receive my test results?
Ans.
Test results are typically available within 24 to 48 hours of sample collection. You will receive your reports digitally through email, WhatsApp, or the lab’s portal.
Q. Is home collection available for this test?
Ans.
Yes, Thyrocare offers convenient home sample collection in most Indian cities. A trained technician will collect your sample from home at your chosen date and time.
Q. Do I need a doctor’s prescription to book this test?
Ans.
No prescription is needed to book this test. However, consulting a fertility specialist or gynecologist after receiving the results is highly recommended for accurate interpretation and next steps.
Q. How often should I take this test?
Ans.
This test is usually done once during the fertility evaluation stage. Depending on your diagnosis and treatment plan, your doctor may suggest repeating some of the tests after a few months to track progress.
